_info: Act 1 of the run. Map: floors floors, width_min–width_max nodes on each, the boss at the top. Node type: bitva (battle), elita (elite), udalost (event), tabor (camp) (the boss is always at the top). first_floor/last_floor = type of the whole floor (first floor all battles, the last before the boss a camp). weights = type weights on the other floors, elite_from = lowest floor with an elite. battles/elites = scenario keys (taken in turn from a shuffled list), boss = boss scenario, events = keys from udalosti.json. regen = how much health (share) a hero heals on his own after a battle, camp_heal = how much the camp heals. Elite: elite_offers offers, elite_picks picks.
name: The Count's Forest
